title: Power Apps: Card gallery, Persona, Avatar group and Metrics card canvas controls reach general availability
notes: claim 66: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the checklist asks makers to review an OnChange formula on Persona, but Microsoft's Persona reference documents OnSelect, not OnChange. The roadmap facts and maker-side settings path are supported; the blanket assertion that the controls read no data on their own also needs narrowing.

claims.quote:
The following controls for canvas apps are reaching general availability:

•	Persona

•	Avatar group

•	Metrics card

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Scope; Governance controls
claims.claim: A maker enables modern controls and themes per app at Settings > Updates > New > Modern controls and themes.
claims.quote: With your canvas app open for editing: 1. On the command bar, select Settings > Updates. 2. Select the New tab and then turn on Modern controls and themes.

claims.claim: No API or automation equivalent for the per-app Modern controls and themes toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps modern controls themes setting PowerShell Set-AdminPowerApp Power Platform API pac admin enable disable; Power Apps modern controls themes Power Platform API administration enable setting canvas app. Read overview, pac admin and Power Apps PowerShell search excerpts.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The capability is maker opt-in, using modern controls in the app designer rather than a documented administrator enablement switch.
claims.quote: Select the New tab and then turn on Modern controls and themes. The app refreshes with the new app authoring menu. Modern controls are part of existing categories.

claims.where: summary; Governance controls; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No administrator action or administrator-level switch specific to these four controls is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card admin disable rollout default existing apps role; modern controls admin disable. Opened all four references and the modern controls overview; no specific admin switch or required admin action found.

claims.claim: Learn does not document individual governance of the four controls through the general Modern controls and themes toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card admin disable rollout default existing apps role. Opened the overview and four control pages; overview documents general app enablement, not four individual governance switches.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether rollout inserts the controls into existing apps.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card admin disable rollout default existing apps role. Opened all four control pages and the modern controls overview; none describes automatic insertion into existing apps.

claims.claim: A rollout mechanism specific to the four controls is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card admin disable rollout default existing apps role. Read the roadmap, four control references and modern controls overview; no feature-specific rollout mechanism found.

claims.claim: The control references do not state a required role specific to these four controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card admin disable rollout default existing apps role. Opened the four control pages and overview; no control-specific role prerequisite found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The four control reference pages name no control-specific licence or meter.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card licensing premium price meter. Opened all four control references and the Power Platform licensing FAQ; the control pages contain no licence or meter section.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; summary; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licensing model specific to the four controls is not yet published, so the feature's model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card licensing premium price meter. Read four control pages, Power Platform licensing FAQ, Power Apps licensing and pay-as-you-go excerpts; no separate model for these controls found. General app licensing remains documented.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing FAQ says access to premium, on-premises and custom connectors requires a standalone Power Apps or Power Automate plan licence.
claims.quote: A standalone Power Apps or Power Automate plan license is required to access all Premium, on-premises, and custom connectors.
claims.fix: The cited FAQ supports the quotation, but qualify its application to canvas apps. Replace the connector-licensing sentence in licensing.notes and the corresponding Cost and licensing paragraph with: 'Apps using premium connectors need an appropriate Power Apps entitlement; the Power Apps per-app pay-as-you-go meter also supports access without a standalone Power Apps licence.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/powerapps-licensing-faq#general and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/pay-as-you-go-meters#how-do-meters-work, which documents access to any type of app without a Power Apps licence. Do not present a Power Automate plan as interchangeable app licensing.

claims.claim: Binding app content to premium connectors introduces the app's connector-related licensing requirements.
claims.quote: A standalone Power Apps or Power Automate plan license is required to access all Premium, on-premises, and custom connectors.

claims.claim: Existing app-sharing and data-connection permissions govern exposure of the data bound into these canvas apps.
claims.quote: Other connections require users to create their own connections and explictly grant security privileges (such as security roles for the Dataverse, OneDrive for Business, SQL Server with Microsoft Entra authentication).
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/share-app-resources to sources for the general app-sharing and connection-permission claim; that page also documents connections implicitly shared with an app.

claims.claim: All four controls read no data on their own.
claims.quote: Searched: Card Gallery Metrics Card data connection; Power Apps Card gallery Persona Avatar group Metrics card admin disable rollout default existing apps role. Read four control references. They document supplied properties and specific presence limitations, not this blanket data-access guarantee.
claims.fix: Replace 'The controls display values a maker supplies and read no data on their own' with 'Makers supply data, presence values and metric calculations through properties and Power Fx', matching the roadmap record. Retain the following Persona-defaults sentence.
